system.description:
Attack Action: an Unarmed Strike against an enemy that deals 2 Sharp and heals you 2 wounds. Each use costs Doom +2, and allies who can see you must pass a CR 1 Strange Check or become Afraid. OPDQ: feed on a dead enemy to heal 4 wounds.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.66
system.summary: Attack Action: an Unarmed Strike against an enemy that deals 2 Sharp and heals you 2 wounds. Each use costs Doom +2, and allies who can see you must pass a CR 1 Strange Check or become Afraid. OPDQ: feed on a dead enemy to heal 4 wounds.

when.label: Each use: every ally who can see you

automation.note: After each use, every ally who can see you rolls Strange CR 1 or becomes Afraid (post this ability to chat, target them and use its Afraid button). Once per Doom Quarter you may instead feed on a dead enemy (no Strike) to heal 4 wounds; track that use yourself.
